title: Too soft as a single pillow but you can engineer
text: Too soft as a single pillow but you can engineer. I often engineer my own firm pillows out of other separate pillows. I aim for an “overstuffed” firm pillow. Individually these pillows as sold here  aren’t that great.  They are frankly understuffed to the point where you won’t have enough filling to support your head. I cut apart the top seam of one pillow and stuffed the other’s contents into it, and then sewed the top.  Yes the pillows are so understuffed you double  the filling in a case and still close the top!  After my 15 minute project, I ended up with a very firm stuffed pillow. But one star for not being remotely useable as they are out of the box
